hypothesis: A 4096-sample short window supplies more reliable chord evidence than 2048 samples and improves fusion with an 8192-sample window.
split: Only the 119 development recordings from global progression families 1 and 2. No progression-3 input or scores.

shared_controls.tuning: Same long-window-derived tuning as the shared cache

confidence_rule: For each normalized chroma vector, compute the difference between the highest and second-highest major/minor template cosine scores. The short-window weight is clip(m_short/(m_short+m_long),0.2,0.8), with 0.5 when both margins are zero. No confidence calibration or temporal smoothing is fitted.
selection: Report every candidate. Eligibility requires at least 0.005 absolute pooled duration-accuracy gain over single_8192 and nonnegative gain in both development progression families. Near-boundary accuracy is a diagnostic, not an optimization target.
cost_scope: Selection may reuse cached chroma; candidate scores do not establish uncached inference speed. Additional 4096 extraction time will be recorded.
no_pivot: No search expansion or parameter changes after observing scores; no test-set evaluation.
